composition: Subtask functional cases ran on build v2 with the same final TaskEditor subtask code. Keyboard functional cases and final diagnostics ran on build v4 with final production code. Build v5 changes only diagnostic attachment logging, leaving its screens, audit types and assertions unchanged; no repeated runtime matrix for logging. Earlier normal v1 had 11 findings; v2 had 10 after the subtask target fix. An interleaved largest audit was interrupted by an XCTest hierarchy/type mismatch; fresh-process v4 completes all eight viewports and retains both failing reports.
limitations: Diagnostic failures remain unaccepted; screenshots do not establish VoiceOver behavior
No full keyboard, contrast, physical-device, cloud or Mac runtime acceptance
Untargeted audit findings are not dismissed; row-fragment hit-area and clipping warnings need targeted triage
reproduction: Copy the isolated xctestrun beside its original in Build/Products and set TaskfoldUITests.EnvironmentVariables.TASKFOLD_RUN_ACCESSIBILITY_AUDIT to 1. Select the two CriticalCaptureAndEditorAccessibilityAudit methods. Without this explicit opt-in they skip; a skip is not a pass.
